OCT 16 HON. ABRAHAM S. SALES Punong Barangay Barangay Dariao Caramoan, Catanduanes Dear PB Sales: This has reference to your letter dated 23 July 2024 requesting for this Department's legal opinion regarding the validity of your suspension as Punong Barangay. According to the representation, Mr. Sandy Zuniega filed a complaint with the barangay about the 4P's beneficiaries, and the Secretary to the Barangay received the complaint and released the blotter report for a price of Php 250. You then claimed that Mr. Zuniega's concern was about his business of lending to 4Ps beneficiaries with interest. You then indicated that you had no jurisdiction over the situation because it is within the jurisdiction of the Department of Social Welfare and Development. Finally, you indicated that there was a complaint filed against you, and the Sangguniang Bayan of Caramoan ordered your suspension as punong barangay because you did not serve summons to the parties including Mr. Zuniega. Thus, the request for legal opinion on whether the abovementioned actions are enough grounds for your suspension as Punong Barangay? At the onset, please be informed that this department is precluded from acting on queries which are presumptively valid acts. DILG Memorandum Order No. 2010-02 dated 17 September 2010 specifically provides: "xxx all concerned are hereby advised that the Department shall not an act on queries of the following kinds, to wit: Xxx 2. Those presumptively valid acts. e.q. enacted ordinances. consummated acts that already eniov the presumption of regularity on the part of the public officer concerned, and similar instances• Xxxx (Emphasis and underlining supplied) Moreover, it is to be emphasized that this Department is an agency under the executive branch of the government and as such, it is devoid of authority to declare any ordinance or resolution approved by local government officials invalid, nor does it have authority "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

to declare invalid or illegal acts committed by local government officials which is alleged to be in violation of the Local Government Code or any other applicable laws. The same must be threshed out before the proper forum. Moreover, the Department does not act on queries which involves presumptively valid acts; e.g. enacted resolutions consummated acts that already enjoy the presumption of regularity on the part of the public officer concerned, and similar instances. In the matter at hand, this Department cannot opine whether your suspension is valid as the Decision of the Sangguniang Bayan of Caramoan enjoys the presumption of regularity. Also, the decision of the Sangguniang Bayan shall be final and executory. 1 However, for purposes of academic discussion, please be advised that Section 60 of R.A. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991 specifically provides for the grounds of suspension and removal from office, to wit: "Section 60. Grounds for Disciplinary Actions. - An elective local official may be disciplined, suspended, or removed from office on any of the following grounds: (a) Disloyalty to the Republic of the Philippines; (b) Culpable violation of the Constitution; (c) Dishonesty, oppression, misconduct in office, gross negligence, or dereliction of duty; (d) Commission of any offense involving moral turpitude or an offense punishable by at least prision mayor; (e) Abuse of authority; (f) Unauthorized absence for fifteen (15) consecutive working days, except in the case of members of the sangguniang panlalawigan, sangguniang panlungsod, sangguniang bayan, and sangguniang barangay; (g) Application for, or acquisition of, foreign citizenship or residence or the status of an immigrant of another country; and (h) Such other grounds as may be provided in this Code and other laws. An elective local official may be removed from office on the grounds enumerated above by order of the proper court." 1 section 61 (c), R.A. 7160 Page 2 of 3

This opinion is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. This is rendered without prejudice to contrary opinion that may be issued by other competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you.
